newsitem.title: USA: Amylin to screen compounds provided by Tripos. [CORRECTED 23:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Amylin to screen compounds provided by Tripos. [CORRECTED 23:08 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects throughout to clarify that Amylin is the company who will screen the compounds.)
Tripos Inc said Tuesday that it and MDS-Panlabs, of Bothell, Wash., agreed to provide chemical compounds for Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc to screen for drug candidates over a one year period.
Amylin will screen for drug candidates for a range of therapeutic targets, including diabetes, obesity and dyslipidemia, Tripos said.
Amylin will pay Tripos an undisclosed up-front fee, plus milestones and royalties based on progress of candidates through development, Tripos said.
